faq.a: Four dishes and a curry paste or sauce made by hand. The menu depends on the day, and most dishes come with chicken or as a vegetarian version.

faq.q: What is on the menu at the lunch class?
faq.a: Monday: Goong Hom Sabi (prawn spring rolls), Tom Kha (coconut soup), Pad Thai with its homemade sauce, mango sticky rice. Wednesday: Kanom Pang Na Gai (chicken on toast), Tom Yam Goong, green curry with its homemade paste, Tub Tim Grob (red rubies in coconut milk). Saturday: Wihok Non Rang (bird-shaped shrimp), Tom Jiw Gai (potato soup with chicken), Pad Thai with its homemade sauce, mango sticky rice.

faq.q: What is on the menu at the dinner class?
faq.a: Tuesday: Poh Pia Puk Tod (vegetable spring rolls), pineapple fried rice, Panang curry with its homemade paste, Buay Loy Kai Wan (rice balls in sweet coconut milk). Thursday: Toong Tong (golden bags), Tom Kha, Khao Pad Ga Prao Gai (holy basil chicken with rice), red curry with its homemade paste. Friday: Som Tum Thai (papaya salad), Tom Yum Goong, Massaman curry with its homemade paste, Tub Tim Grob.
Yes. The partner chef option, where you share a station and make a double portion, is made for children from 5 to 12 cooking with a parent. Tell us their ages.
Yes, on the lunch class (Monday, Wednesday, Saturday). You go to the local market with the chef before cooking. The dinner class starts with the story of the ingredients instead.

legacyText.title: Thai Cooking Class Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
intro: The class is held in a cooking school on Koh Lanta. The morning class runs on Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays from 9:00 to 14:00, market visit first. You leave with your apron, a recipe booklet, a certificate and a box for what you could not finish.
The school also teaches fruit and vegetable carving, with your creations to take home, on weekday mornings or afternoons depending on the day.
legacyText.cardDescription: A visit to the local market, then cook Thai dishes with a local cook. Suitable for children.
goodToKnow: Morning class on Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays. Evening class on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Fridays, from 16:00 to 21:00.
Carving class: Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays from 15:00 to 18:00, Tuesdays, Thursdays and Fridays from 9:00 to 12:00.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht. The morning and evening cooking classes cost the same.
